title: I Am the Vine
question: What does Jesus say fruit actually depends on?
blurb: Branches don't strain to produce grapes. See what Scripture says about staying connected.

nodes.content: What does Jesus say fruit actually depends on?

nodes.verseText: I am the vine and you are the branches. The one who remains in Me, and I in him, will bear much fruit. For apart from Me you can do nothing.
Remain in Me, and I will remain in you. Just as no branch can bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in Me.
This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.
He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
rooted and built up in Him, established in the faith as you were taught, and overflowing with thankfulness.
